questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs mark a no passing zone.

questions.question: Is it legal to drive while holding a pet on your lap?

options.text: Yes, if the animal is asleep.
Yes, but it is not recommended.

questions.explanation: Holding an animal on your lap while driving is illegal and dangerous. If you cause a moving violation while distracted, you can be charged with distracted driving in addition to other penalties.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It means you cannot go in that direction.

questions.question: Vehicle stopping distances do NOT depend on:

options.text: Your vehicle's tire condition and type.

questions.explanation: Stopping distance depends on reaction time, weather, visibility, vehicle weight, brake condition, tire condition and type, road conditions, and speed. The time of day does not affect stopping distance.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions. This sign tells you a stop sign is coming ahead. Be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether or not there is a stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children cross the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must yield to pedestrians in a crosswalk. Watch for children and be alert at intersections and when turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of a winding road with three or more curves ahead.

questions.question: How can you reduce the risk of hydroplaning?

options.text: Do not speed on wet roads.
Keep tires filled to the correct air pressure.

questions.explanation: Hydroplaning happens when your vehicle slides on water between the tires and road. Low tire pressure, worn tread, and speeding all increase hydroplaning risk.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must or must not do. This sign means U-turns are not allowed wherever it is posted.

questions.question: What should a driver do if they see an animal on the road?

options.text: Pass the animal as close as possible.

questions.explanation: Be very cautious when you see an animal on the road. Pass it slowly so you don't scare it.

questions.question: Why is it important to leave space between your vehicle and others?

options.text: It prevents distractions from other vehicles.
It gives you time to react to sudden situations.
It keeps traffic moving at a safe speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: It gives you time to react to sudden situations.
questions.explanation: Space between vehicles gives you time to react if other drivers make mistakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: When is street racing allowed?
questions.explanation: Street racing is illegal and causes serious injuries or deaths. Illegal street races happen on public roads. High speeds mean drivers cannot react to hazards or other situations, which causes crashes.

questions.question: What is the best way to avoid hydroplaning?

options.text: Keep your tires in good condition.
Slow down when roads are wet or slushy.
Watch for standing water or puddles.

questions.explanation: On wet roads, cars need more distance to stop and may skid on sharp turns. Do not use cruise control in wet or icy conditions. Slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that left turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What is the only way to lower your blood alcohol concentration (BAC)?

options.text: Wait for your body to process the alcohol.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait for your body to process the alcohol.
questions.explanation: Time is the only way to lower your BAC. Coffee, exercise, and cold showers cannot reduce BAC or make you sober. They may keep you awake, but they do not change your BAC.

questions.question: Which of these commonly causes traffic accidents?

options.text: Driving too fast for road conditions

questions.explanation: Speeding is a major cause of crashes. Not paying attention can cause collisions with other vehicles. Most rear-end crashes happen because drivers follow too closely.

questions.question: What should drivers do at a flashing red traffic light?

options.text: Drive through if there is no oncoming traffic.
Continue driving because you have the right-of-way.
Stop only if a police officer is nearby.
Treat it like a stop sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat it like a stop sign.
questions.explanation: Flashing red lights are used at dangerous intersections. Treat them the same as stop signs.

questions.question: To be ready for anything on the road ahead, you should:

options.text: Look at the entire road and both sides.
Stare straight ahead at all times.
Drive with your left foot resting on the brake pedal.
Focus on the middle of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look at the entire road and both sides.
questions.explanation: Your ability to avoid dangers depends on finding problems before you reach them. Look ahead, but do not just stare at the center of the road. You need to look at the entire road, including both sides.

questions.question: You can carefully drive through an intersection with a yellow light if:

options.text: There is an emergency vehicle crossing your lane.
You are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow.
questions.explanation: If you are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow, you can continue through it carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means you cannot park here.

questions.question: When you approach railroad tracks, you should:

options.text: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
Speed up to cross before the gate closes.
Ignore how many tracks you need to cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: When approaching railroad tracks, look and listen for trains. Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.question: What helps a person recover from drinking alcohol?
questions.explanation: Only time will help a person recover from the effects of alcohol.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has many curves and turns.

questions.question: If another car is about to hit you, you should:
questions.explanation: Use your horn to warn other drivers or pedestrians of danger. If another driver is about to hit you, sound your horn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can pass a slow vehicle if you do it quickly.
You can pass if you know the road.
You can pass only at night.

questions.explanation: Regulation signs are white with black markings. Drivers must obey all regulation signs. This sign means passing is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means that action is not allowed. Right turns are not permitted where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a school crossing is ahead.
